source_title: Silicom Reports Q3 2026 Results - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
- Return to Non-GAAP Profitability ahead of initial expectations -
- 71% revenue growth backed by strong Design Win momentum -
KFAR SAVA, Israel , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Silicom Ltd. (NASDAQ: SILC ) , an industry-leading provider of high-performance server/appliance networking solutions, today reported its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
Third quarter: Silicom's revenues for the third quarter of 2026 reached $26.7 million, up 71% from $15.6 million for the third quarter of 2025.
On a GAAP basis, the Company recorded a net loss of $0.3 million, or $0.06 per ordinary share (basic and diluted), compared with a net loss of $2.8 million, or $0.49 per ordinary share (basic and diluted), in the third quarter of 2025, an improvement of 88%.
On a non-GAAP basis (as described and reconciled below), the Company recorded net income of $0.3 million, or $0.04 per ordinary share (basic and diluted), compared with a net loss of $2.1 million, or a net loss of $0.36 per ordinary share (basic and diluted), for the third quarter of 2025.
First Nine Months: Silicom's revenues for the first nine months of 2026 rose by 55% to $69.6 million, compared with $45.0 million in the first nine months of 2025.
On a GAAP basis, net loss for the period totalled $4.8 million, or $0.84 per ordinary share (basic and diluted), a 46% improvement compared with $8.9 million, or $1.57 per ordinary share (basic and diluted), for the first nine months of 202 5.
On a non-GAAP basis (as described and reconciled below), net loss for the period totalled $2.1 million, or $0.37 per ordinary share (basic and diluted), a 66% improvement compared with a net loss of $6.1 million, or $1.08 per ordinary share (basic and diluted), for the first nine months of 2025.
Based on highly predictable recurring revenues from the company's Design Win platform, revenues for the fourth quarter are expected to reach $27 - $28 million, representing 66% year-over-year growth at the upper end of the guidance. As a result, full-year 2026 revenue projections are being raised once again to $96 - $98 million, representing 57% year-over-year growth.
Liron Eizenman, Silicom's President and CEO, commented, "We are pleased to report outstanding third quarter revenues of $26.7 million, a 71% increase over Q3 2025. Driven by strong execution and the significant leverage inherent in our business model, we returned to non-GAAP profitability well ahead of our initial expectations. These results reinforce our confidence in the strength of our target markets, the effectiveness of our execution, and the soundness of our strategic plan."
Mr. Eizenman continued, "Our growth continues to be fueled by strong Design Win momentum. The Design Wins we secure today drive growth for years to come, making them one of the most important indicators of our future performance. The two new Design Wins we added this quarter bring our year-to-date total to eight, already exceeding the low end of our full-year guidance while positioning us on track to meet or exceed the high end.
"Our pipeline remains deep and diverse, with opportunities across our entire product portfolio - Edge systems, Smart NICs and FPGA - as well as AI Inference, White Box Switches, and Post-Quantum Cryptography. We are particularly encouraged by the success of our strategic plan, which is giving us the means to invest both in our core business and in the significant long-term potential upside of AI Inference, a natural extension of our core expertise, capabilities, customer base and IP roots."
Mr. Eizenman concluded, "Taken together, these achievements demonstrate clearly that Silicom has passed an inflection point. Customer demand continues to expand, growth momentum continues to build, and our return to profitability marks a significant milestone. With accelerating revenues and our business fundamentals strengthening, we expect to close 2026 on a high note, carrying this exceptional momentum into a highly promising 2027."

Silicom Ltd. is an industry-leading provider of high-performance networking and data infrastructure solutions. Designed to optimize performance and efficiency in Cloud, Data Center and Edge environments, Silicom's solutions increase throughput and minimize latency, serving as the infrastructure backbone for today's most critical technologies. Our innovations empower high-demand workloads across Artificial Intelligence (AI) inference, SD-WAN, SASE, cyber security, fabric switching, NFV, and more.
Our comprehensive portfolio, including high-speed server adapters, advanced hardware offloading and acceleration engines, AI NICs, FPGA-based smart cards, Post Quantum Cryptography (PQC) hardware accelerators, white label switches and Edge CPEs, is used by Tier-1 customers throughout the world, including cloud players, service providers and OEMs, to enable their networks to scale efficiently. With engineering excellence, a strong financial position and a legacy of over 400 active Design Wins, Silicom serves as the "go-to" connectivity and performance partner for technology leaders around the globe, and drives the next generation of infrastructure.
For more information, please visit: www.silicom.co.il
